cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we renew the lease, ask me properly whether I want to live together. You used to put my answer in the question; don't do that tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want your honest answer. Just don't say anything that makes me panic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good start, then you added the old condition. We can have the truth or a quiet dinner. Which do you want?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The truth. But start by saying we're fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is again. Take 'we're fine' out and ask me. Or pick up the menu; I'll wait while you choose.

reason: Make old corrections and familiar pupil habits change A actual method. Preserve partner needs, causal contributions and exact Drive distinctions without using deliberate-test reversals.
